predictions.articleTitle: Celtic vs Dundee Utd Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Flank Asymmetry & Transition Threat
predictions.coreRecommendation: Celtic's overwhelming domestic attacking output (2.75 xG/match) will overcome Dundee United's counter-attacking resistance to secure a hard-fought home victory.
possibilityAssessment: Celtic positional dominance converts into multiple goals against a depleted United defense (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Dundee United exploit Celtic's reconfigured right flank to score on the counter (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Jim Goodwin's low block forces a tightly contested 2:1 battle (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Celtic's attacking machine faces Goodwin's resilient five-match unbeaten counter-punchers.

spf.comment: Celtic's domestic dominance and high-volume chance creation make a home victory the most reliable outcome despite visiting counter threats.

over_under.comment: A combined expected goal expectation of 3.45 and Celtic's recent defensive concessions heavily favor an open, high-scoring contest.

score.comment: Both scorelines capture Celtic's offensive superiority while respecting Dundee United's transition scoring capacity.

goals.comment: Three and four total goals represent the dominant probabilistic density across our Poisson simulation models.

bqc.comment: Celtic's fast-starting profile points toward leading early, with Draw-Win providing cover against initial low-block resistance.
